SELECT DISTINCT T1.PTL_ID, T3.ASSET_NAME ptlName, T1.SUB_CODE, T1.SUB_NAME, T1.SUB_CLASS, T1.ASSET_SOURCE, T1.FINPROD_ID, T2.ASSET_ID AS FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T2.ASSET_NAME AS FINPROD_ABBR, T2.TRADE_MARKET, T1.MARKET_ID tblMarketId FROM RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP T1 LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN chb_asset_info T3 ON T1.PTL_ID = T3.ASSET_CODE AND T3.ASSET_TYPE = '12'
where exists (select 1 from RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP T2 where T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '1002%' /** 排除活期存款1002**/ AND (T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '1204%' OR T2.SUB_CODE like '120406%') /** 排除活期存款利息1204**/ AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2206%' /** 排除应付管理人报酬2206**/ AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2207%' /** 排除应付托管费2207**/ AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2209%' /** 排除应付交易费用2209**/ AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2221%' /** 排除应付税费2221**/ AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2222%' /** 排除预估税费2222**/ AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2501%' /** 排除预提费用2501**/ AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2801%' /** 排除其他应付款2801**/
AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2231%' /** 排除应付利息2231**/ AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '3003%' /** 排除清算款3003**/ AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '1021%' AND T2.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '1031%' AND T1.PTL_ID = T2.PTL_ID AND T1.SUB_CODE = T2.SUB_CODE) and T1.SUB_CLASS not in ('ZHG','NHG') /**回购资产无需做映射 **/
#{item}
and T1.FINPROD_ID is not null
and T1.FINPROD_ID is null
order by T1.SUB_CODE

SELECT PTL_ID, SUB_CODE, FINPROD_ID FROM RSK_VALTBL_PRT_BOTASSET_MAP
AND PTL_ID = #{ptlId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT ASSET_CODE as FINPROD_ID, /**行内资产负债编码 **/ ASSET_NAME as FINPROD_ABBR, /**资产名称**/ ASSET_ID as FINPROD_MARKET_ID, ASSET_TYPE2 as FINPROD_TYPE2, TRADE_MARKET FROM chb_asset_info /**资产要素表**/ WHERE ASSET_CODE = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT OBJECT_ID, SECNAME FINPROD_ABBR, SECID FINPROD_MARKET_ID, MARKET TRADE_MARKET FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO where SECID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT count( 1 ) FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB where PTL_ID = #{ptlId} and SUB_CODE = #{subCode} and FINPROD_ID is null
mapper.update: update RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB set FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} where PTL_ID = #{ptlId} and substring(SUB_CODE,9) = substring(#{subCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},9) and FINPROD_ID is null
update RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB c set FINPROD_ID = null where PTL_ID = #{ptlId} and substring(SUB_CODE,9) = substring(#{subCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},9)
